title: Living High is Not a Crime

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Living High is Not a Crime is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Howdy, I've got a nice little job for you. A guy came to me recently, says he used to know Reshala. Real high roller dude. Nice suit, signet ring the size of a bottle cap. I ran into him once before during a business dispute, think he drove a black BMW. He says war is war, but he still wants to decorate his place... his hideout, to be exact. Bring me as much jewelry and as many fancy trinkets as you can. I'll pass them along to him. Golden horse statues, cats, lions, anything like that will do. And see if you can find a gold Roler watch too. That'll be a little bonus. Trust me, brother, it's better to stay on good terms with people like him. Don't let me down, or it'll be bad for both of us."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 2 Bronze lion figurines in raid
- Find 2 Horse figurines in raid
- Find 2 Golden rooster figurines in raid
- Find 2 Cat figurines in raid
- Find 2 Roler Submariner gold wrist watches in raid
- Find 2 Golden eggs in raid
- Hand over 2 Bronze lion figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Horse figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Golden rooster figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Cat figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Roler Submariner gold wrist watches to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Golden eggs to Ragman

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.75
- 275,000 Roubles
  - 288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Thank you, brother. I'll pass everything along. Fine jewelry like this is always a welcome sight. I've got a feeling he's gonna like it."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid |
| Bronze lion figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Horse figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |

| Roler Submariner gold wrist watch | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Golden egg | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on Interchange. Alternatively, they, along with the Roler Submariner gold wrist watch and Golden egg can be found in Safes. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as Drawers, Sport bags, Dead Scavs, and more.
